name: Uni-Mol + multi-view readout
tagline: Replaces the [CLS]-only pooler of Uni-Mol with a fused readout over [CLS], attention pooling, and pair-representation summaries.

key_hyperparams.name: K
key_hyperparams.role: multi-sample dropout copies averaged at training

key_hyperparams.name: p_drop
key_hyperparams.role: dropout rate inside each multi-sample copy

key_hyperparams.name: d_pair
key_hyperparams.role: compressed pair-feature dim per pair view

init_recovers: Uni-Mol [CLS] head when attention-pool and pair branches are zeroed.
diff_from_baseline: Code as displayed has an IndentationError on line 354 — the first `MultiViewReadout` is cut off mid-method and a duplicate class header restarts the definition; the displayed file is the agent's final (broken) edit while the leaderboard score is from an earlier successful test (#2). Intended design: keeps the Uni-Mol pretrained encoder verbatim but swaps the simple dropout+linear ClassificationHead for a four-view fusion ([CLS], attention-weighted atom pool, [CLS]-row pair summary, diagonal pair summary) followed by multi-sample dropout averaging.

name: Uni-Mol + D-MPNN cross-attention
tagline: Fuses Uni-Mol [CLS] with a parallel D-MPNN bond branch and RDKit descriptors via a residually-gated cross-modal attention readout.
formula: $$\alpha = \mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\frac{(W_q h_{\mathrm{CLS}})(W_k[\,h^{\text{UM}}\Vert h^{\text{DMP}}])^\top}{\sqrt{d_b}}\right),\;\; c = \gamma\,\mathrm{LN}\!\big(\alpha\, W_v[\,h^{\text{UM}}\Vert h^{\text{DMP}}]\big),\;\; \hat y = W_o[\,h_{\mathrm{CLS}}\Vert c\Vert\tilde r_{\text{RDKit}}]$$
init_recovers: Uni-Mol + RDKit logistic head when γ=0.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a parallel chemprop-style D-MPNN bond branch and cross-modal attention from the Uni-Mol [CLS] query to the concatenated atom-token / D-MPNN keys, then concatenates RDKit 2D normalized descriptors with the gated context for the final linear head.

name: Geometry-gated GNN with disagreement gating
tagline: Two-branch GNN with RBF-distance-gated message passing and a per-task disagreement gate that mixes graph and geometry logits.
formula: $$g_e = \sigma\!\big(W_g(\phi_e(e_{ij}) + W_d\,\mathrm{RBF}(\lVert p_i - p_j\rVert))\big),\;\; \hat y = \mathrm{sig}\!\big(W_m[\,h_g\Vert h_{\text{geo}}\Vert |y_g-y_{\text{geo}}|]\big)\odot y_g + (1-\cdot)\odot y_{\text{geo}}$$
init_recovers: Pure geometry head when gate→0; pure graph head when gate→1.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the GIN starter with a geometry-gated edge convolution (RBF over interatomic distances modulating bond messages) and adds a parallel geometry pathway over per-atom radial features; the final logits are a sigmoid mixture whose gate sees the absolute disagreement between the two heads.

name: D-MPNN with 3D-distance gating
tagline: Distance-aware D-MPNN whose bond messages are scaled by a Gaussian of pairwise 3D distance, with multi-head attention readout and RDKit fusion.
formula: $$w_{ij} = \exp\!\big(-\tfrac{\lVert p_i - p_j\rVert^2}{2\sigma^2}\big),\;\; h^{(t+1)}_{ij} = \mathrm{ReLU}\!\big(h^{(0)}_{ij} + W_h\big(\sum_{k\to i} w_{ki}\, h^{(t)}_{ki} - h^{(t)}_{ji}\big)\big)$$

key_hyperparams.name: σ
key_hyperparams.role: Å bandwidth of the 3D distance Gaussian gate

key_hyperparams.name: global_query
key_hyperparams.role: learnable readout query for attention pooling

init_recovers: Chemprop D-MPNN + RDKit features when σ→∞ (uniform gate).
diff_from_baseline: On top of the D-MPNN baseline, multiplies each directed bond message by a Gaussian of the 3D distance between the source and destination atoms, replaces sum readout with a learned-query multi-head attention pool, and concatenates both pooled vectors with RDKit features for the head.

name: GeoGIN + Uni-Mol token + RDKit
tagline: GIN whose messages carry an edge-type-conditioned distance gate, augmented by frozen Uni-Mol token embeddings and an RDKit descriptor branch.
formula: $$w_{ij} = \sigma\!\big(W_w\,\phi_d(d_{ij}, t_{ij})\big),\;\; h_v' = \mathrm{MLP}\!\big((1+\varepsilon)h_v + \sum_{u\to v} w_{uv}\,(h_u + W_e e_{uv})\big),\;\; \hat y = W_o[\,\bar h \Vert W_r \tilde r_{\text{RDKit}}]$$

key_hyperparams.name: num_edge_types
key_hyperparams.role: atom_type x atom_type x bond_type bins

init_recovers: Plain GIN + RDKit when the distance gate w→1.
diff_from_baseline: Extends the GIN starter with an edge-type-conditioned distance encoder that gates each message via sigmoid, concatenates a frozen slice of the pretrained Uni-Mol token embedding to the atom features, and fuses an RDKit 2D descriptor branch at readout.
